note: Public Mapzen elevation tiles in a 1.4 km east-west by 1.0 km north-south aperture across the west face of Thor Peak. Tilezen documents ArcticDEM and Canadian elevation as sources at this latitude; per-tile provider headers are absent, so their precise local mix is not asserted. Horizontal distances and elevations retain metre units; vertical exaggeration is 1×. A single-valued DEM cannot represent the overhang and rounds the steep face. This is a cropped terrain surface, not a complete rock-face scan or a surveyed 1,200 m cliff-height measurement. No summit-height adjustment or gap filling is performed by this builder. A separate direct ArcticDEM service trial had major no-data holes and was rejected. No crop walls, underside, stand, independent ruler or schematic geometry is included.
